votes.motion: Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to close the open session of the staff meeting to discuss real property
Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to close the staff meeting and go into the public meeting
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to accept the financial report

Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the resolution declaring a need for the Housing Authority of the County of Salt Lake to exercise its powers within the boundaries of the Magna Metro Township

Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to approve the resolution authorizing the Mayor to provide a letter of support for certain actions of the Housing Authority of Salt Lake County, pursuant to federal requirements
Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the nonexclusive wireless telecommunications franchise agreement
Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the resolution and Letter of Support for the Arts Council of Magna grant application
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve the Magna Metro Township logo and seal
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to continue Application #30632 to the August 28, 2018, Council meeting at the request of the developer Bryon Prince
